titleAr: دعوة موظف وشيله من الفريق (من غير متجر)
titleEn: Invite and remove teammates (workspace without a Store)

en: How do I invite a teammate to my Chat workspace?
How do I remove a teammate?

steps: Team > Invite a teammate (first name + email) > Send invite; the person accepts the invitation after signing in
Team > Cancel invitation / Remove from team
edgeCases: Standalone workspaces only: a Store workspace's team is managed in Ebda Store
An invitation is not access: the person gets a seat only after they accept, signed in as the invited identity; it expires after 7 days and can be cancelled
The owner sees only the name and address they typed until the person accepts; the answer to an invite is the same whether or not the address already has an account
The package's member limit applies; the owner cannot be removed; removal ends access on the person's next request
At most 20 invitations a day per workspace and 30 per owner
assistantNote: an invite emails a link; access starts only when the person accepts; cancel the invitation or remove the person to undo
